+    expect(restoreResult.state).toBe(state)

+

+      onSuccess: onSuccessSpy,

+    const observer = new QueryObserver(client, { queryKey: key })

+    expect(result.status).toBe('error')

+      queryFn: () => Promise.resolve('fresh'),

+        errorUpdateCount: 2,

+        fetchFailureReason: liveError,

+      const persistedState: QueryState<string> = {
+        data: 'persisted-newer-data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 200,
+        dataUpdateCount: 2,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 50,
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureCount: 0,

+        data: 'data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 100,
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 0,

+import type { DefaultError, QueryStatus } from './types'
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+
+export const persisterRestoreResultSymbol = Symbol.for(
+  'tanstack-query:persisterRestoreResult',
+)
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  data?: TData
+  state: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+  [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    ...result,
+    data: result.data !== undefined ? result.data : result.state.data,
+    state: result.state,
+    [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(value: unknown): value is PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (value as any)[persisterRestoreResultSymbol] === true
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  liveState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  persistedState: Partial<QueryState<any, any>> & { data?: any },
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  const liveDataUpdatedAt = liveState.dataUpdatedAt
+  const persistedDataUpdatedAt = persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  // 1. Data freshness:
+  let data: TData | undefined
+  let dataUpdatedAt: number
+  let dataUpdateCount: number
+
+  if (persistedState.data === undefined && liveState.data !== undefined) {
+    data = liveState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = liveDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = liveState.dataUpdateCount
+  } else if (
+    liveState.data === undefined &&
+    persistedState.data !== undefined
+  ) {
+    data = persistedState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = persistedState.dataUpdateCount ?? 1
+  } else if (persistedDataUpdatedAt > liveDataUpdatedAt) {
+    data = persistedState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount =
+      persistedState.dataUpdateCount ?? liveState.dataUpdateCount + 1
+  } else {
+    data = liveState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = liveDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = liveState.dataUpdateCount
+  }
+
+  // 2. Error freshness:
+  let error: TError | null
+  let errorUpdatedAt: number
+  let errorUpdateCount: number
+  let fetchFailureCount: number
+  let fetchFailureReason: TError | null
+
+  const liveErrorUpdatedAt = liveState.errorUpdatedAt
+  const persistedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  if (persistedState.error != null && liveState.error == null) {
+    if (persistedErrorUpdatedAt >= liveErrorUpdatedAt) {
+      error = persistedState.error
+      errorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+      errorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? 1
+      fetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? 1
+      fetchFailureReason = (persistedState.fetchFailureReason ??
+        persistedState.error) as TError | null
+    } else {
+      error = liveState.error
+      errorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt
+      errorUpdateCount = liveState.errorUpdateCount
+      fetchFailureCount = liveState.fetchFailureCount
+      fetchFailureReason = liveState.fetchFailureReason
+    }
+  } else if (liveState.error != null && persistedState.error == null) {
+    if (liveErrorUpdatedAt >= persistedErrorUpdatedAt) {
+      error = liveState.error
+      errorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt
+      errorUpdateCount = liveState.errorUpdateCount
+      fetchFailureCount = liveState.fetchFailureCount
+      fetchFailureReason = liveState.fetchFailureReason
+    } else {
+      error = null
+      errorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+      errorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+      fetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+      fetchFailureReason = (persistedState.fetchFailureReason ??
+        null) as TError | null
+    }
+  } else if (persistedErrorUpdatedAt > liveErrorUpdatedAt) {
+    error = (persistedState.error ?? null) as TError | null
+    errorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount =
+      persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? liveState.errorUpdateCount + 1
+    fetchFailureCount =
+      persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? liveState.fetchFailureCount
+    fetchFailureReason = (persistedState.fetchFailureReason ??
+      null) as TError | null
+  } else {
+    error = liveState.error
+    errorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount = liveState.errorUpdateCount
+    fetchFailureCount = liveState.fetchFailureCount
+    fetchFailureReason = liveState.fetchFailureReason
+  }
+
+  const isInvalidated = Boolean(
+    liveState.isInvalidated || persistedState.isInvalidated,
+  )
+
+  let status: QueryStatus
+  if (error != null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (data !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status = persistedState.status ?? liveState.status
+  }
+
+  return {
+    data,
+    dataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount,
+    error,
+    errorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason,
+    fetchMeta:
+      (persistedErrorUpdatedAt > liveErrorUpdatedAt
+        ? persistedState.fetchMeta
+        : liveState.fetchMeta) ?? null,
+    isInvalidated,
+    status,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+  }
+}
